📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text.
  2. Counts update automatically.
  3. Read paragraphs, sentences, words and blank lines.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as a paragraph?

Paragraphs are blocks of text separated by one or more blank lines.

Are blank lines counted?

Yes — blank lines are reported separately so you can check your spacing.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No — everything is counted locally in your browser; nothing leaves your device.
